name: Panther Habit
oracle_text:
If equipped creature would be dealt damage, prevent that damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Equip {2}
blocked_sentences: If equipped creature would be dealt damage, prevent that damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.what: a static replacement on the permanents a filter names (here `affects: {attached: true}`) that prevents all damage that would be dealt to each of them and, as part of the same replacement (no trigger, no stack), puts that many counters of a named kind (+1/+1) on the creature that would have been dealt the damage -- e.g. a `prevent_damage` static option `counters_instead: {"counter": "+1/+1"}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` static prevents damage to the affected permanents but carries nothing that does anything with the prevented amount; `replace_damage` is only a multiplier; and the `damage_prevented` trigger event is scoped to the player half (Selfless Squire, damage dealt to you), exposes no value for the prevented amount, and would in any case be a triggered ability using the stack rather than the printed replacement, so the counters would arrive late (on the stack, respondable, after state-based actions) instead of as the damage event is replaced
